research.notes: Anti-chip PVC is robot/airless-sprayed on sills/wheel arches (wet-on-wet before primer). Spec 'P8201' not found publicly. Source row was duplicated. Local context: JV Uz-Dongju Paint Co (Asaka/Uzbekistan; UzAvtosanoat + Korean DongJu/KION) was set up to supply UzAuto with pretreatment chemicals (3750 t/yr), sealants (1250 t/yr) and automotive paints, and its 2024 privatisation required keeping GM-standard compliance. It is a plausible local maker/distributor of the RSB/RSU sealers and possibly pretreatment/ED materials (unconfirmed; uzdongju.uz not reachable from this session). | REVIEW: Sikagard-6682 removed (water-based sound deadener, not PVC anti-chip). | round2_A: P8201 not found. No PVC-plastisol-specific anti-chip TDS found (3M/Sika results are rubber/alkyd refinish, excluded). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Graco XL10000/XL6500 air-motor manuals are pump drive components (weak passports; kept). 3A7301ES is confirmed by search as the Spanish King XL10K pump/spray package manual (rev K), fine. The duerr endless-dosing datasheet is a battery-gluing doc and the German duplicate of the round-1 EN sheet. The Atlas Copco LASD leaflet is a sound-deadener dispensing doc, adjacent class only. TEROSON PV 3145 TDS: not found by search (searches for 'TEROSON PV 3145' only return PV 3046, a PVC seam sealer). The URL follows the valid Henkel TDX pattern but is UNVERIFIED and may not exist; check it before use. | Round3: TEROSON PV 3145 URL removed (product not found in any search; URL likely constructed).

research.notes: CR-100 and spec KR-APC-707U/742U not found publicly. Best hypotheses: (a) Uz-DongJu Paint (Asaka-based JV, est. 1995/96, listed among UzAuto main suppliers; 2024 buyer pledged GM-standard compliance) producing to GM Korea 'KR' specs, possibly under Korean licence; (b) KCC Corporation (largest Korean OEM paint maker, GM Korea supplier; signed 2025 Uzbek automotive-paint plant agreement). No PDF of the exact product found. KCC US4000 (refinish 2K primer surfacer) is only a loose family equivalent. Only plant-specific evidence found: 2023 Asaka modernization (uzdaily/kun.uz) mentions FANUC robots in press shop and maintenance of 'robotic systems' in the paint shop without naming vendors; GM Korea Changwon paint shop (2021) uses 78 Dürr robots. Equipment below is REPRESENTATIVE, not confirmed for Asaka. | round2_B evidence: Daryo.uz (2024-06-22, https://daryo.uz/en/2024/06/22/uzbekistans-sama-sell50-stake-ofuz-dongju-paint-for19bn/): Uz-DongJu Paint's main production facility is in Asaka; the buyer of the 50% state stake pledged to keep product compliance with General Motors standards and OEM requirements; products under 'Royal Paint' brand incl. paints, varnishes, sealants and car-body chemicals. GoldenPages.uz (https://www.goldenpages.uz/en/company/?Id=9727) lists automotive paints, primers and urethane varnishes, 'plant for production of automotive... paints... for GM'. Strengthens Uz-DongJu as the supplier; Korean technology partner still unconfirmed. Exact products (CR-100, HITEC 2000, KR- thinners) not found publicly. | round2_B: 'CR-100' not found under any manufacturer (EN/KO searches). No public OEM 1K solventborne surfacer TDS/SDS from PPG/BASF/Axalta/KCC located; OEM products are distributed under restricted access. No exact doc. Search budget exhausted before Dürr/ABB mixing-room/solvent recovery searches could be completed. | round3_review: REVIEW round3: Uz-DongJu Paint JV as UzAuto paint supplier: CONFIRMED by search (uzavtosanoat.uz lists 'Uz Dong Zhu Paint' among main UzAuto Motors suppliers; Daryo 2024 says the buyer is committed to GM standards/OEM requirements; Golden Pages calls it a paint plant serving GM). That it makes these specific products is still inference, so manufacturer_confidence 'medium' is right, and 'low' for the thinners. Korean technology partner (KCC/Noroo) not confirmed. KCC UU3000 is a 2K refinish primer-surfacer and the Hoffmann guide is a waterborne formulation, while CR-100 is probably a solvent-borne 1K bake surfacer. Both are weak class equivalents (labelled 'equivalent', OK). GMW3002 GlobalSpec and the ABB RB1000i page are HTML (file null), fine. EcoRP E043i datasheet and robot-stations brochure (orch): plausible official durr.com paths, but the filename was not found in search results. RB1000-SSD (solvent-borne standard) is the right atomizer variant.
